arguments.script: var scene=UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene();if(scene.name!="Level05_Cave")throw new System.Exception("Wrong scene");int removed=0;for(int pass=0;pass<8;pass++)foreach(var t in scene.GetRootGameObjects().SelectMany(g=>g.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.Transform>(true)).Reverse().ToArray())if(t&&t.childCount==0&&t.GetComponents<UnityEngine.Component>().Length==1&&(System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(t.name,@"^F\d\d_Piece\d+")||t.name=="Terrain Grid"||t.name=="Unified Terrain Grid"||t.name.StartsWith("Floor ")||t.name=="Preserved irregular terrain")){UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(t.gameObject);removed++;}var m=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>().Single(m=>m.name.StartsWith("Jump King"));UnityEditor.Selection.activeGameObject=m.gameObject;var v=UnityEditor.SceneView.lastActiveSceneView;v.in2DMode=true;v.LookAt(new UnityEngine.Vector3(12,118,0),UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity,10,true,true);v.Focus();v.Repaint();UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.MarkSceneDirty(scene);UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.SaveScene(scene);System.IO.File.WriteAllText("scripts/jk-tilemap-20261111/final-scene.txt","Removed empty legacy holders="+removed+"; Tilemap count="+UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>().Length+"; static terrain colliders="+scene.GetRootGameObjects().SelectMany(g=>g.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.Collider2D>()).Count(c=>c.gameObject.layer==6&&!c.isTrigger)+"; scene saved");
arguments.summary: Remove empty legacy terrain holders and leave editable fifth-level Tilemap selected
